issues: 工作台按 130f 渲染，镜头本意 160f，成树后的呼吸收尾（132–160f）整段被裁掉
孙层节点 x=810/1110 宽 300，两张卡边缘几乎相贴，布局拥挤
prompt 写的是 ER 图，节点里却只有灰色骨架条，读不出是实体表
连线 5px 灰色直角折线，粗笨；节点 spring 从 scale 0 放大，像 PPT 弹出
prompt 条 3px 灰边敲完瞬间跳成黑边，没有提交动作；背景平灰点阵
changes: 补导出 DIAGRAM_CASCADE_BUILD_DURATION = 160，完整演出打字→提交→级联→呼吸
节点换成 ER 实体卡：表图标 + 表名 23px + 列数，两行等宽字段（PK 强调色胶囊 / FK 灰胶囊 / 类型），表头先出、字段晚 3f 依次滑入
连线改 2px 圆角折线（r=16，pathLength 归一描线 16f），父/子端口白点在线到达时 overshoot 弹出；节点 0.82→1 + 上浮 14px + 阴影随高度收紧
prompt 条加 AI 图标、强调色光标与提交键：敲完描边转强调色 + 5px 焦点环，提交键点亮并按下 10f 后根节点出现；柔光画布 + 渐隐点阵
issuesEn: The workbench rendered 130f while the shot needs 160f, so the breathing finish after the tree completes (132–160f) was cut
Grandchild nodes at x=810/1110 with 300px width almost touch each other
The prompt asks for an ER diagram but nodes only hold grey skeleton bars, so they never read as tables
Connectors are 5px grey square elbows; nodes spring up from scale 0 like a slide-deck pop
The prompt bar's 3px grey border snaps to black when typing ends with no submit action; flat grey dotted background
changesEn: Added DIAGRAM_CASCADE_BUILD_DURATION = 160 so typing → submit → cascade → breathe all play
Grandchildren evenly spaced at 420px (330/750/1170/1590), children at 540/1380, leaving 120px between siblings
Nodes are ER entity cards: table icon + 23px name + column count, two monospace field rows (accent PK pill / grey FK pill / type); header first, fields slide in 3f apart

Connectors are 2px rounded elbows (r=16, normalised pathLength drawn over 16f) with white parent/child ports popping when the line arrives; nodes rise 0.82→1 with a 14px lift and shadows tightening on landing

Prompt bar gains an AI glyph, accent caret and submit button: on completion the border turns accent with a 5px focus ring, the button lights and presses 10f before the root appears; soft-lit canvas with a fading dot grid
